TDK, Maxell, and Memorex Blank Audio Cassette Tapes
10 Piece Lot with Storage Case
Type I and Type II Formulations
This collection features 10 vintage blank audio cassette tapes from leading manufacturers TDK, Maxell, and Memorex. These tapes represent the standard for analog home recording from the late 1980s through the 1990s, offering a mix of Type I Normal Bias and Type II High Position (Chrome) formulations. The lot is accompanied by a TDK-branded soft nylon carrying case designed for secure storage and transport of a cassette library.
5 TDK High Position Type II tapes: includes two SA-90 and three SA-X100 cassettes
4 Maxell UR 90 Normal Bias Type I tapes for everyday recording

TDK/Coast branded black nylon soft case with zipper closure and internal organizers
Condition:
All 10 cassette tapes are factory sealed in their original cellophane packaging. The nylon storage case is in good condition with a fully functional zipper and intact interior slots. The external branding and logo patches are clear and legible. Sold as-is due to the nature of vintage magnetic media.

Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Description
: Explore Earth's ancient past with this 12-piece Fossil Collection Kit, perfect for science enthusiasts and collectors alike. Each fossil is individually bagged and accompanied by an educational card describing its origin and significance, including gastropods, pelycopods, horn coral, crinoid stems, brachiopods, trilobites, dinosaur bone, ammonites, fossil wood, algae, and shark teeth. The set includes a colorful timeline card mapping major periods of prehistoric life, making it a valuable educational tool. Ideal for students, teachers, or hobbyists, these fossils offer hands-on learning about natural history and paleontology. All items shown are included, and each fossil appears in its own clear, labeled packet for easy viewing and storage. The set is presented in good visible condition, with all key contents intact and readable. Delight in the tactile experience of real fossils and enrich your educational collection or science display with this fascinating assortment.

title: Vintage Glass Insulator 3 Piece Lot Hemingray O.V.G. Co Aqua Green Damaged
description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.

description:
Title:
Mineral Specimen White Crystal Slice Geode Section Natural Formation 8 Inch
Category:
Collectibles & Art
Description:
Elevate your collection with this captivating white crystal geode slice, perfect for display or mineral enthusiasts. This specimen showcases an intricate crystalline formation radiating from a central opening, revealing striking transparency and natural geometric patterns. The rough exterior edge contrasts beautifully with the flat, polished face, enhancing the brilliance and depth of the crystals within. At approximately 7 inches across (as shown by the ruler), it offers substantial presence whether showcased on a shelf or used as a sophisticated accent piece. Its sturdy build and unique visual appeal make it ideal for collectors, educators, or anyone seeking natural beauty for their decor. The condition appears very good overall, with clean surfaces and only minor natural roughness on the edges. Please refer to photos for the exact condition and dimensions before purchasing.

description: This listing includes an assorted collection of natural mineral specimens featuring selenite sticks, an amethyst cluster, and quartz geodes. The quartz geodes are large with white to clear crystal interiors. There are three semi-transparent, striated selenite sticks included. Set of Orthoceras Fossils from Silurian Morocco Polished Shell Specimens
This listing offers a set of Orthoceras fossils from the Silurian period, sourced from Morocco. The fossils are embedded in a dark gray matrix and feature well-preserved, polished shell segments with distinct chamber divisions characteristic of Orthoceras cephalopods. The set includes multiple pieces of varying sizes, with the largest measuring approximately 18 cm (7 inches) in length. A labeled mounting plate with specimen information is attached on the back. Fossils are in good condition with natural surface variations, suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or decorative display.

" will
not

*Items receiving a tracking number AFTER 1 pm will not have tracking info updated until the next business day at the earliest. Items receiving a tracking number after 1 pm on Friday's will not have the tracking info updated until the following Monday at the earliest.
*We do not participate in Third Party Shipping or Courier Services at this time.
*Orders $100 and above will be subject to automatic signature service. For special requests,
please contact us prior to payment.

We do NOT offer any shipping options faster than FedEx Ground and we only follow their packaging guidelines. Due to the odd dimensions of certain items, FedEx may charge more for shipping oversize items and may calculate that into shipping weight as a "dimensional weight." Any special requests for alternate packaging arrangements may incur an additional handling fee charge to be paid before shipment. For more information on Dimensional Weight please visit:(https://www.fedex.com/in/tools/dimweight.html).

Combined Shipping:
Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may NOT be combined with an unpaid item. Items may be combined for shipping as long as the follow criteria are met;
Items are from the same selling Goodwill.
Items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for ANY of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 lbs.
If your auction items meet the above criteria, the site will prompt to automatically combine all available orders during the payment process. If the site does not automatically do this, please submit a customer service ticket and some exceptions may be made.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This collection includes six vintage writing instruments featuring primarily Cross brand pens and pencils, along with a Bradley 'Black Gold' set and a Japanese-made fountain pen.

Specifications:
- Cross pens: Black and gold tone slimline ballpoint and mechanical pencil models with original cases.
- Bradley set: Black and gold accented pen and pencil with original box and insert, featuring a 'Black Gold' theme.
- Fountain pen: Japanese-made with a black body, silver geometric band, and an additional cap.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This framed oil painting features an elderly man with a long white beard, wearing a woven straw hat and holding a smoking pipe. The artwork is rendered in a realistic style with visible brush strokes and a soft, muted color palette.

Specifications:
- Medium: Oil on canvas
- Subject: Elderly man with straw hat and smoking pipe
- Style: Realistic with visible brush strokes
- Color Palette: Soft, muted tones
- Frame: Bamboo-style wooden frame with textured brown mat
- Backing: Black paper with hanging wire
- Dimensions: 23.5 x 19.5 inches including frame

Additional Details:
The frame exhibits a rustic, vintage appearance. There are no visible artist signatures or identifying marks on the front.

This vintage professional-grade paint set was manufactured in Japan by Nishi Works, Ltd. under the "Guitar" brand name. Featuring a sophisticated mid-century graphic aesthetic, the set contains 18 tubes of opaque water color, a medium often referred to as gouache, known for its flat, matte finish and high pigment density. The yellow enameled metal tin serves as both a storage case and a mixing palette, featuring ten integrated rectangular wells in the lid for color blending.
Set includes 18 individual metal paint tubes with original grey screw caps
Features colors such as Vandyke Brown (208), Burnt Sienna (207), and Chrome Green Light (215)
Original enameled metal tin with iconic Guitar logo and "Made in Japan" markings
Formulas labeled as lead-free and non-poisonous as per original vintage packaging

The interior paint tubes are in varying states of use; while caps are present, the paint inside may have hardened or dried due to age and is sold as a collectible item. The interior cardboard organizer shows light staining from paint contact.
